mapper.select: SELECT AUTH_CODE AS authCode, CLIENT_ID AS clientId, USER_SEQ_NO AS userSeqNo, SCOPE AS scope, REDIRECT_URI AS redirectUri, USED_YN AS usedYn, EXPIRES_AT AS expiresAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM MOCK_KFTC_OAUTH_CODE WHERE AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}

SELECT TOKEN_HASH AS tokenHash, CLIENT_ID AS clientId, USER_SEQ_NO AS userSeqNo, SCOPE AS scope, REVOKED_YN AS revokedYn, EXPIRES_AT AS expiresAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM MOCK_KFTC_OAUTH_TOKEN WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE MOCK_KFTC_OAUTH_TOKEN SET REVOKED_YN = 'Y' WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND REVOKED_YN = 'N'
mapper.sql: FINTECH_USE_NUM AS fintechUseNum, BANK_CODE AS bankCode, BANK_NAME AS bankName, ACCOUNT_NO AS accountNo, HOLDER_NAME AS holderName, USER_SEQ_NO AS userSeqNo, BALANCE AS balance, LEADER_YN AS leaderYn, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM MOCK_KFTC_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_CODE = #{bankCode} AND REPLACE(ACCOUNT_NO, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{accountNo}, '-', '')
SELECT FROM MOCK_KFTC_ACCOUNT WHERE FINTECH_USE_NUM = #{fintechUseNum} FOR UPDATE
